note: Martin County, TX has no public zoning polygon service. The county does not appear to zone; the city of Stanton (county seat) publishes its zoning only as a static PDF map (Stanton-Zoning-Map-2020.pdf) and ordinance text on ecode360/municode. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and county/CAD sites found no zoning FeatureServer or MapServer layer; parcel vendors (Regrid, texascountygisdata, Equator) list zoning only sparsely or not at all.
